talking_points: Donald Trump has threatened a 'tremendous tax' on US firms building data centres abroad, putting him on a collision course with Big Tech's global cloud strategy.
Nvidia shares fell 13% after reports emerged that the SEC is probing how the chipmaker discloses revenue from Singapore and China.
Anthropic says one of its researchers helped crack the 150-year-old Riemann hypothesis, while coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks to more than double its valuation to $75bn.
